purpose: This table provides cleaned, hourly weather observations (temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, precipitation, visibility) for three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) for downstream flight-delay and operations analytics.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to flight or airport-level facts; consumers must handle nulls deliberately in wind_dir, wind_speed, pressure, and especially wind_gust (74.6% null) rather than assuming zero or average values, and should treat date parts (year, month, day, hour) as derived calendar attributes consistent with time_hour.
limitations: wind_gust is retained despite a 74.6% null rate and should not be relied upon for complete coverage; pressure (11.5% null) and wind_dir (1.7% null) also carry non-trivial missingness. No duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied, and the origin plus time_hour grain is a reasonable but not warehouse-verified uniqueness assumption that a human reviewer should confirm.
